name: Portal
description: Renders children into a DOM node outside the current React tree using createPortal. Defaults to document.body; accepts a custom container element.

notes: Portal does not add any ARIA attributes itself.
Content rendered inside a Portal must manage its own accessible roles and attributes.
Portals do not affect the React event bubbling order — events still bubble through the React tree.

children.description: Content to teleport into the target container.

container.description: Target DOM element to render children into. Defaults to document.body when null.

do: Use Portal as the rendering layer for overlays, tooltips, modals, and drawers.
Pass a custom container when you need to scope the portal within a specific DOM subtree.
dont: Do not rely on Portal for z-index stacking — manage that with z-index tokens on the content.
Do not render portals during server-side rendering without a defined container.
